description: This file defines an interface for reading client charge information in the Fineract platform, including methods to retrieve all charges for a client with filtering options and to retrieve specific charge details.

classes.name: ClientChargeReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface providing methods for reading client charge data from the platform.

methods.name: retrieveClientCharges
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of client charges based on client ID, status, pending payment status, and search parameters.

methods.name: retrieveClientCharge
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific client charge by client ID and charge ID.
